proof_body:
by
  intro f P Q hf hP hQ p
  have hf' : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) := hf.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) p := (hf'.differentiable one_ne_zero) p
  have e : ∀ w v : ℝ × ℝ, fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ f q w) p v = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) p v w := by
    intro w v
    rw [(hd2.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const w p)).fderiv]
    simp
  have eP : P = fun q => fderiv ℝ f q (1, 0) := funext fun q => (hP q).symm
  have eQ : Q = fun q => fderiv ℝ f q (0, 1) := funext fun q => (hQ q).symm
  rw [eP, eQ, e, e]
  exact hf.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp) _ _
target_source: ∀ (f P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 f → (∀ q, fderiv ℝ f q (1, 0) = P q) → (∀ q, fderiv ℝ f q (0, 1) = Q q) → ∀ p, fderiv ℝ P p (0, 1) = fderiv ℝ Q p (1, 0)
